gloss: to take up (a position); to assume

definitions.gloss: to take up (a position); to assume (a role)
definitions.explanation: To start occupying a position, job, or role. Often used for taking on new responsibilities or positions.
To settle into bed or go to sleep. Common in formal or literary contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{職|しょく}→職：00376_shoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{就|つ}いた。
examples.english: I took up a new job.
To assume the position of president.

examples.japanese: {床|とこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{就|つ}く⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧だ。
examples.english: It's time to go to bed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧{教職|きょうしょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{就|つ}いた。
examples.english: He took up teaching right after graduating from university.
My grandfather goes to bed by nine every night.

examples.japanese: {長旅|ながたび}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{疲|つか}れ→疲れ：03518_tsukare⟧で、⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着|つ}く→着く：00680_tsuku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}り→眠り：13673_nemuri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{就|つ}いた。
examples.english: Worn out from the long trip, I fell asleep as soon as I got home.

notes:
{就|つ}く means to take up a position, role, or state. Written with the kanji {就|つ} to distinguish it from other つく verbs.

TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧). Always takes the particle ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{職|しょく}→職：00376_shoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{就|つ}く: to get a job, to take employment
- ⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{就|つ}く: to take one's seat
- {任|にん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{就|つ}く: to assume a post/duty
- {床|とこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{就|つ}く: to go to bed (formal/literary)
- {位|くらい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{就|つ}く: to ascend to the throne

ASPECT (ている):
{就|つ}いて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ means "is in (a position)" — resulting state.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{就職|しゅうしょく}→就職：03209_shuushoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to get employed
- ⟦{就任|しゅうにん}→就任：12368_shuunin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to take office
- ⟦{就寝|しゅうしん}→就寝：09947_shuushin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to go to bed (formal)
